```python
def parse(line):
    """Split a CSV line into exactly 3 fields, trimming surrounding whitespace.

    Return None when the line does not contain exactly three fields.
    """

    return fields
```

```python
def evaluate(rules, facts):
    """Evaluate a rule against facts.

    {"all": [...]} is True when every named fact is truthy.

```
